Practised the role and structure of India’s courts.
Identified civil matters: property ownership, contracts, rent, family matters, and money disputes.
Identified criminal matters: theft and assault.
Explored appeal from District Court to High Court and named Rajasthan High Court.
Teach-back on court structure and appeal was not passed.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised sorting civil and criminal examples using the table and board, then worked on the order of District Court, High Court, and Supreme Court. They revisited the civil/criminal mix-up and corrected it for theft, property ownership, and assault. At home, ask them to explain one civil example, one criminal example, and the usual appeal path aloud.
